column3: All right! Perfect score!
Well, yes... you did hit all the SNATCHERS, but you hit all the civilians, too.
Hey, Metal, check this out! Perfect score!
Yes, indeed. Perfect score. And you didn't miss any civilians, either.
Well, you know. That was by accident.
That still does not excuse it!
Nice job, Gillian. You managed to hit everything that moved, including civilians.
And you also had a lot of wasted shots. You have to use less ammo, and learn to choose your targets better.
Well, you see... I'm sort of the "more the merrier" type when it comes to shooting.
Your blaster does have an energy limit, you know.
No wasted shots, and you seem to be in good control of your weapon.
Now all you need is to improve your target selection -- civilian or SNATCHER.
Yeah, yeah. I'm not exactly a rookie, you know.
As long as you're aware of what areas you need work on, you'll be fine.
Well, you didn't waste many shots, but you must avoid hitting civilians.
Hmm. I thought I was getting used to this.
Confidence is fine, but over-confidence can be fatal! You should always be ready to learn anew.
Hey, I could say the same thing about you!
Hey! Perfect! How about that? No complaints with that one, eh?
Hitting all the SNATCHERS is wonderful, but you picked off a few civilians, too.
Yeah, but you never know. They might be SNATCHERS, too!
True, but you cannot shoot unless you're absolutely sure. That's the way Junkers operate.
Absolutely sure? Hey, I've been in some pretty tight spots, you know.
Ah, yes. Another slightly blemished "perfect" performance.
You wasted a lot of shots, as well. You need to improve your concentration and judgment.
I'm so intent on boosting my accuracy that I can't tell the targets apart.
You're a pro now, Gillian. You must have confidence.
Yes, but comments like that tend to make me lose it.
Just a little bit more practice! No wasted shots...all you need to do is avoid hitting civilians.
Damn! I was so close...
Don't worry, Gillian. You're getting better all the time.
Yeah, but things are really different out there on the streets.
Well, you haven't wasted many shots, but you must avoid hitting civilians at all costs.
Yeah, but controlling this trigger happy finger of mine is the hardest thing to do.
Wow! A perfect score at top Runner level! Great work, Gillian!
Great job, Gillian!
All right! Another perfect score!
What!? Another perfect score? You're unbeatable!
Good work! A perfect score, Gillian!
All right! Yet another perfect score! (Of course, a good teacher can make any pupil shine...)
Huh? Did you say something Metal?
No, nothing Gillian. You're getting much better.
All right! Another perfect score!
Ah! Another perfect round! You've gotten much better, Gillian.
You are wasting a lot of shots. You have to work on reducing those.
Absolutely amazing! And no wasted shots either!
You even got all the human SNATCHERS, too. You're truly a fine runner, Gillian.
Yet another perfect round! And no wasted shots! What more can I say?
Amazing! I take my hat off to you!
An excellent job, Gillian. And no wasted shots, either. You're a fine runner.
Another perfect round, eh? And no wasted shots. You can't get much better than this.
Amazing! It would seem that this practice level is too easy for you.
Your practice results were good in Act 1, too.
After all, Mika says that you were getting perfect scores right off the bat.
You're on the right track. All you need to do is reduce the number of wasted shots.
Well, you have gotten better, but you are still hitting all the civilians.
And you are wasting a lot of shots. If you don't reduce those, you could get into real trouble out on the streets.
Well, you are not wasting any shots, but shooting everything that moves like that just won't do.
You have to be more relaxed. Your opponents are quite cruel, you know.
You aren't wasting too many shots, and your control appears to be good.
All you need to do is pick your targets better. Judgment mistakes will get you killed.
You're doing quite well, but you just have to avoid shooting civilians.
You are still wasting too many shots. You need to concentrate more.
Well, you are not wasting any shots. Now all you need to do is concentrate more.
You are not wasting too many shots, but you still need to pick your targets better.
Not too bad. You didn't hit any civilians.
Still, the high number of wasted shots is troublesome. Your accuracy needs work.
You aren't wasting any shots, so further practice should help you immensely. You seem to have good control.
You are not wasting too many shots, but your accuracy still needs improving. Still, you are picking your targets well.
What are you doing? Why are you shooting all the civilians?
And you are wasting too many shots. Remember, you're aiming for the SNATCHERS!
This is no time for games, Gillian! You shot the civilians on purpose, didn't you?
Not again?! You're no longer a rookie, you know. You must take practice seriously!
Do you have problems dealing with others, or something?
That murderous instinct that Mika was talking about appears to be for real.
What happened? This is quite distressing!
Why are you shooting all the cute little civilians?
You've been like that since Act 1, haven't you...
Come to think of it, Mika mentioned something about that...
She said she thought you may have a killer streak in you.
Stop aiming for civilians and do this right, Gillian!
It looks like this level is way above your head.
I'll set the machine back to intermediate level for the next session.
It looks like this level is a little to difficult for you.
It seems that this level was a little rough on you, right Gillian?
You're not hitting anything! Gillian, pull yourself together!
You are wasting a lot of shots, too. It's about time that you settled down.
You are not wasting any shots, but you have to avoid hitting civilians.
Your control is not to bad, but you need to pick your targets better.
You appear to need quite a bit more practice. Pick your target, aim carefully, and fire.
It looks like this level is way above your head.
I'll set the machine back to intermediate level for the next session.
It looks like this level is a little to difficult for you.
It seems that this level was a little rough on you, right Gillian?
What's this? You didn't hit any civilians, but you didn't hit anything else, either!
You are simply wasting too many shots. At this rate, your next patrol is bound to be your last.
You cannot just spray shots like that. Pick your target, and then squeeze the trigger.
Gillian, you didn't even pull the trigger once!
Pull yourself together, Gillian!
I just don't get fired up unless it's the real thing.
You'll lose that bad attitude pretty quickly if you get killed out there.
Gillian, are you serious about this?
Don't bother practicing if you are not going to put your heart into it.
It looks like this level is way above your head.
I'll set the machine back to intermediate level for the next session.
It looks like this level is a little to difficult for you.
It seems that this level was a little rough on you, right Gillian?
Your results are satisfactory, but you have to avoid hitting civilians.
You're wasting a lot of shots, too. I'm sure you're aware of this, but the SNATCHERS are the enemy.
You aren't wasting any shots, but that's not good enough. You're still hitting civilians.
Gillian, you know mistakes are not allowed around here.
Boosting your accuracy without hitting civilians is the key.
Unless you focus on that, you'll end up a murderer.
You still need a lot of practice. You're accuracy is poor, but worse than that, you're hitting too many civilians.
You're wasting too many shots. At this rate, you won't stay alive long out on the streets.
You are not wasting any shots, but you still need more practice.
You've cut way down on the number of wasted shots, but you are still hitting a few civilians.
Typical...
You're picking your targets well...no hits on civilians.
But you are wasting a lot of shots and your accuracy is low. You need to keep practicing.
You didn't waste any shots, but you still need more practice.
You need to shorten your reaction time without hurting your target selection. And you should cut down the number of wasted shots.
...Gillian. You've got the rapid-fire feature turned on, don't you?
Oh, you noticed, eh?
I can't believe you would sink so low...
I was just playing a shooting game, and I must have left it on by mistake.
Your excuses are getting better all the time.
But it's still not forgiven!!
Gillian!! Not the rapid-fire button again!?
Yeah. I had it on.
Stop this nonsense immediately!
All right, all right.
Turn off the rapid-fire feature, all right?
You got Mika upset, then you did it again in Act 1...
Is this some kind of sick habit of yours?
That's just the way I live, you know.
That habit got Mika quite upset at you, remember?
Haven't you conquered that habit yet? It was causing trouble back in Act 1, too.
And you're missing a lot of the human-type SNATCHERS as well.
You have to relax and pick your targets.
You still seem to be having trouble picking out the human-type SNATCHERS.
You have to cut down on the number of human-type SNATCHERS that you miss.
Make sure you hit the human-type SNATCHERS as well.
...nevertheless...
...perhaps this level is a little too difficult for you.
I'll put the machine back on intermediate for the next round.
Metal! Wait!
All right. I'll leave it on this level as long as you stay in this room.
